main_text.l: Seductores hos hodiernâ die reos ago: Amor-sapientiæ (partes hæ tuæ sunt) sedeto pro tribunali: Adsisti-te, quibus a præjudicatis opinionibus vacuum pectus, & justam judicum facite decuriam: Vobis judicibus pedum iis extorquebo de manibus: intensum ad viam indicem, cæteris digitis æquabo, & flectam in pugnū: insidiosam dexteram, usque & usque aventem inseri axillæ, religabo post tergum: Ducis illa insignia, Ducis hæc munia: soli debentur Rationi: soli vindicabo Rationi.

marginalia.note: Horum nomina Geniorum, ad Philosophiam defero: Eos de fraude postulo.

page.notes: The marginal note at the left is set in small italic type and partly damaged; its reading is approximate ("Horum nomina Geniorum, ad Philosophiam defero: Eos de fraude postulo."). The word "Seductores" has a large woodcut-style initial S. Some letters in the text are uncertain due to scan quality. The facing page edge at the right is show-through and was omitted.
